description: [Accra] Public Transport Terminals is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. Polygon footprints of 106 public transport terminals and stations in the Greater Accra Metropolitan Area, digitised as part of the GUMAP trotro mapping campaign. Attributes include the terminal name, the name used locally, alternative names, and operating hours where recorded. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Accra, Ghana, Public Transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
